comment: IPC benchmark targets and floors (docs/ipc.md, Benchmarks). scripts/check-bench.mjs --enforce fails when a measured value is worse than its floor; CI enforces floors on Linux only. Floors sit at about half of what a shared container measured with only 2 CPUs (as a private repository's Linux runner has), so slow runners never fail them; a null floor is reported only. Megabytes are 10^6 bytes.
